data.text: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
data.titulo: Blessed Are Those Who Walk in the LORD’s Ways

data.text: You will eat the fruit of your hands’ labor; you will be blessed, and it will go well with you.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
Indeed, this is how the man who fears the LORD will be blessed.
May the LORD bless you from Zion; may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
data.titulo: May the LORD Bless You from Zion

data.text: May you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
